body_markdown:
## New capability runs AI Skills automatically on a set cadence and delivers insights straight to managers' inboxes, closing the gap between knowing what to coach and coaching consistently


Today we announced Scheduled Skills in Ambition, the latest addition to our suite of agentic features. Scheduled Skills lets leaders, managers, and reps run any Ambition Skill automatically on the cadence they choose, with results delivered to their email inbox before the moment they need them.


This update is designed to address the sales coaching inconsistencies shown to negatively impact performance. In Ambition's industry survey, only 30% of organizations coach on a weekly or bi-weekly cadence, and 35% describe coaching quality as highly variable across managers. Scheduled Skills removes barriers by turning a team's coaching rhythm into a system that runs on its own.


“Building AI for revenue teams was never about a smarter chatbot you have to remember to open. It’s creating a system that does the work before you ask,” said Jenn Chavez, Head of Product at Ambition. “Scheduled Skills is a big step toward that. Effective coaching stops being a goal and becomes something that actually runs, every day, every week, every quarter.”


With Scheduled Skills, users at every level of the revenue organization can:


- **Run Skills on their own cadence.** Schedule any Skill a user has access to, including shared Company Skills built by admins, to run on a recurring cadence.
- **Get insights in the inbox.** Results are delivered by email, ready ahead of 1:1s, team meetings, and leadership reviews.
- **Coach from real context.** Paired with Ambition Coaching Intelligence, scheduled outputs draw on what was discussed and committed to in prior coaching sessions, not just how the numbers moved.
- **Stay within existing permissions.** Every scheduled output respects the user's own data access, and every figure traces back to Ambition's Performance Graph.


Scheduled Skills is the latest release in Ambition's Agentic Ambition roadmap. Learn more about Ambition's new agentic experience at[ambition.com](https://ambition.com/product/capability-ai-agent-skills) .
